title: Uplink
description: Uplink represents an inter-cluster service advertisement. A child cluster declares an Uplink to advertise to a parent cluster that it can handle a particular workload. This advertisement gets automatically materialized into a service on the parent layer. The parent can then route traffic to the advertised workload.

entryPoints.description: EntryPoints lists the uplink entrypoint names associated with this uplink. If not specified, defaults to all uplink entrypoints marked as default, or all uplink entrypoints if none are explicitly marked.

healthCheck.description: HealthCheck configures the active health check on the load balancer service generated for this uplink.

passiveHealthCheck.description: PassiveHealthCheck configures the passive health check on the load balancer service generated for this uplink.

weight.description: Weight is used for load balancing across multiple clusters referencing the same uplink. Higher weights receive proportionally more traffic.
